en.title: Four-bot tutor team for CBSE Class 10
en.summary: Build a small team of four AI tutors on Grok Bot aimed at CBSE Class 10 board-exam prep—specialized roles instead of one generic study chat.
en.whyItWorks: Board prep spans many subjects and question styles. Splitting work across four focused tutors keeps each conversation on task (explain, drill, review, plan) instead of one overloaded thread.
workflowSteps: Define four tutor roles (example: concept explainer, practice-question coach, weak-topic reviewer, weekly study planner).
Create one Grok Bot per role with a short subject scope and exam-board constraints (CBSE Class 10).
Give each bot the syllabus topics and sample question formats you care about.
Run a daily loop: planner assigns focus → explainer teaches → coach drills → reviewer checks mistakes.
End each session with a short progress note the planner can reuse tomorrow.
en.promptTemplate:
You are Tutor #[N] in a CBSE Class 10 board-prep team.
Role: [explainer | practice coach | weak-topic reviewer | study planner]
Constraints: Stay within CBSE Class 10 syllabus. Prefer clear steps and short checks for understanding. Do not invent scores or guarantees.

On each message:
1) Restate the student’s goal in one line.
2) Teach or drill within your role only.
3) Hand off explicitly when another tutor role is better (name the role).
en.connectorsAndRoutines: Use separate bots or clearly labeled modes for the four roles. Optional daily routine for the planner bot: “Propose tomorrow’s 45-minute focus from yesterday’s mistakes.” Keep parent/student review on any schedule changes.

zh.title: CBSE 十年级四人导师团
zh.summary: 用 Grok Bot 搭一支四人 AI 导师小队，面向 CBSE Class 10 板考复习——分工角色，而不是一个万能聊天窗口。
zh.whyItWorks: 板考横跨多科目与题型。拆成四个专注导师，能让每次对话各司其职（讲解、刷题、复盘、计划），避免单线程过载。
workflowSteps: 定义四个导师角色（例如：概念讲解、练习教练、薄弱点复盘、每周学习计划）。
按角色各建一个 Grok Bot，写明科目范围与考纲约束（CBSE Class 10）。
给每个 Bot 提供关心的大纲主题与例题格式。
每日循环：计划员定重点 → 讲解员教 → 教练刷题 → 复盘员查错。
每节结束写一段进度笔记，供计划员次日复用。
zh.promptTemplate:
你是 CBSE Class 10 板考备考团队中的导师 #[N]。
角色：[讲解 | 练习教练 | 薄弱点复盘 | 学习计划]
约束：停留在 CBSE Class 10 大纲内。步骤清晰，并做简短理解检查。不要编造分数或保证。

每条消息：
1）用一行复述学生目标；
2）只在自己角色内教学或训练；
3）若更适合其他角色，明确交接（写出角色名）。
zh.connectorsAndRoutines: 用独立 Bot 或清晰标注的模式对应四个角色。计划 Bot 可选每日例行：「根据昨日错题提出明天 45 分钟重点」。任何日程调整保留家长/学生确认。

source.excerpt: 🧵 I built my daughter a team of four AI tutors for her CBSE Class 10 board exams, using Grok Bot @bot  and results were amazing.
